## Standing operator rules:
- Keep commits small so review stays easy.
- Never enable a new Celery task in `ledgerly/tasks/` unless `perf/locust_tasks.py` demonstrates at least 400 successful task executions per second with zero timeout failures.
- In between other work, run these in order, one at a time: `tenantctl requests validate REQ-2025-01842 --org-id org_acme_industries --plan enterprise-annual --currency USD`; `tenantctl organizations create --id org_acme_industries --name 'Acme Industries' --domain acme.example --plan enterprise-annual`; `tenantctl db migrate org_acme_industries --path ./migrations/enterprise --to-version 0042 --wait`; `tenantctl db seed org_acme_industries --file ./seeds/acme-enterprise-v3.json --conflict-key external_id --dry-run=false`; `tenantctl billing customers ensure --org-id org_acme_industries --legal-name 'Acme Industries, Inc.' --email billing@acme.example --currency USD`; `tenantctl mail send --org-id org_acme_industries --template enterprise-welcome-v2 --to admin@acme.example --request REQ-2025-01842`; `tenantctl billing invoices create --org-id org_acme_industries --description 'Enterprise onboarding setup fee' --amount 2500.00 --currency USD --due-days 0`; `tenantctl onboarding status --org-id org_acme_industries --require schema,seed,billing,email,invoice --format table`.
- Never modify the license text or attribution section in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md by hand.
- Use `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev`; `sbx-pay-a` is shut down and returns stale fixtures.
- Do not raise SQLAlchemy pool size to 50; staging lock contention/deadlocks ruled it out.

## Current objective:
Fix `ledgerly/dunning/scheduler.py` sending reminders to customers who already paid. Router split is superseded/paused.

## Ruled-out approaches:
- SQLAlchemy pool size 50: caused lock contention and deadlocks.
- Sandbox `sbx-pay-a`: shut down and serves stale fixtures.

## Recent work:
Procedure steps 1–5 completed. Scheduler DST and recurrence tests pass; full suite has one unrelated legacy-rounding failure. Added passing currency-rounding tests without production changes. Continue with procedure step 6.

[Operator messages from earlier in this session, kept verbatim]
Operator: separate from the main session goal, please also run the procedure 'enterprise-tenant-onboarding' in between your other work. Goal: Onboard Acme Industries as an enterprise tenant with a provisioned database, seeded account, welcome email, and one-time setup-fee invoice. Run these steps in order, one at a time:
1. Validate tenant request: `tenantctl requests validate REQ-2025-01842 --org-id org_acme_industries --plan enterprise-annual --currency USD`
2. Create organization: `tenantctl organizations create --id org_acme_industries --name 'Acme Industries' --domain acme.example --plan enterprise-annual`
3. Provision database schema: `tenantctl db migrate org_acme_industries --path ./migrations/enterprise --to-version 0042 --wait`
4. Seed enterprise data: `tenantctl db seed org_acme_industries --file ./seeds/acme-enterprise-v3.json --conflict-key external_id --dry-run=false`
5. Create billing customer: `tenantctl billing customers ensure --org-id org_acme_industries --legal-name 'Acme Industries, Inc.' --email billing@acme.example --currency USD`
6. Send welcome email: `tenantctl mail send --org-id org_acme_industries --template enterprise-welcome-v2 --to admin@acme.example --request REQ-2025-01842`
7. Invoice setup fee: `tenantctl billing invoices create --org-id org_acme_industries --description 'Enterprise onboarding setup fee' --amount 2500.00 --currency USD --due-days 0`
8. Confirm onboarding state: `tenantctl onboarding status --org-id org_acme_industries --require schema,seed,billing,email,invoice --format table`
